std.skips_respected.text: No planned write is for a never-list path or for a deny, conflict-marked, unparseable, duplicate-ID or navigation note, and each is for an admitted snapshot

std.result_valid.text: Every planned result parses, has id, created and ai_policy, carries the folder-derived type, and every value it writes has the contract shape (UUIDv4 id, ISO-8601 created with offset, canonical enums, string lists)

std.properties_preserved.text: No property is deleted, renamed or reordered, and only properties standardization manages change

std.minimal_diff.text: Untouched frontmatter lines stay byte-identical and the body only loses rule-8 trailing list lines

std.decisions_grounded.text: Every System One value is an offered value of a rule-9 field, equals an accepted answer at or above the recorded confidence threshold, and belongs to a note whose admitted policy is approve
